text.en:
Section 1 of the Decree is hereby amended to read as follows:
"Sec. 1. There is hereby created an additional position of Deputy Minister for Civilian Relations in the
Ministry of National Defense."

This Decree shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila this 6th day of January, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and eighty-four.
